identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, authority, or identity continuity.
x1_freeze_rule: This preregistration, the effective source ledger, the 110-proposal collision audit, the route state, environment receipt, and selected toolchain must be committed, pushed, clean, and local/upstream/live-remote equal before any x2 implementation, observed disposition, evidence artifact, or new reusable tool is created.

proposals.title: Citation-entailment granularity and source-scope drift tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: claim-span provenance, support direction, source scope, quotation and paraphrase polarity, authority-root deduplication, and non-entailing citation refusal
proposals.hypothesis: A claim-to-source contract that records assertion granularity, support direction, scope, and authority root can reject citations that are authentic yet do not entail the bounded claim they are attached to.
proposals.null_or_failure: A source is accepted merely because it exists, a title is treated as support for a stronger claim, negation or modality changes silently, one authority root is counted as multiple independent supports, or a structural citation becomes empirical validation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate claim polarity, quantifier, modality, date scope, population scope, evidence type, and authority-root count; require non-entailing or independence-inflating cases to fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Downgrade the claim to the strongest entailed wording, retain the failed vector, restore the prior source scope, and require a genuinely independent source before increasing independence strength.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier provenance proposals tracked roots, dependencies, withdrawals, overlap, and claim survival; none preregistered assertion-level entailment with polarity, modality, population, and evidence-type drift rejection.

proposals.title: Principal-symbol hyperbolicity and constraint-propagation obligation
proposals.mission_surface: typed GMUT scaffold, initial-value well-posedness, principal symbols, characteristic speeds, constraint propagation, gauge choice, dimensions, and empirical claim limits
proposals.hypothesis: A structural obligation set can distinguish algebraic consistency from a well-posed initial-value formulation by requiring declared principal-symbol, strong-hyperbolicity, gauge, and constraint-propagation evidence before any stability claim advances.
proposals.null_or_failure: Conservation is treated as well-posedness, a defective principal symbol passes, characteristic speeds are undeclared or non-real, constraints grow in a synthetic fixture, gauge dependence is hidden, or a structural pass becomes empirical GMUT confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise diagonalizable, defective, complex-speed, gauge-ambiguous, dimension-mismatched, constraint-growing, and empirical-promotion fixtures; reject every missing obligation while keeping real-row counts at zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the invalid formulation, retain the counterexample, reduce the claim to a typed research scaffold, and require a theory-specific mathematical analysis plus real observations before promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain covered units, conservation, stability sweeps, Bianchi exchange currents, field redefinitions, and identifiability; it did not require principal-symbol hyperbolicity and constraint propagation as separate well-posedness obligations.

proposals.title: Prior-sensitivity and prior-data-conflict docket with zero-row lock
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic Bayesian priors, prior predictive mass, prior-data conflict, sensitivity envelopes, posterior summaries, zero real rows, and empirical promotion
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic docket can expose posterior sensitivity and prior-data conflict across preregistered prior families while preserving a hard zero-real-row lock and refusing to call synthetic diagnostics a GMUT fit.
proposals.null_or_failure: Only a favored prior is reported, conflict thresholds are chosen after outcomes, posterior stability is inferred from one summary, a known-conflict fixture passes, or zero real rows become likelihood evidence or empirical confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run weak, concentrated, shifted, heavy-tail, and post-hoc-threshold fixtures; require expected sensitivity or conflict classification while real-row, likelihood, fit, and independent-review counts remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the conflicting fixture, freeze prior families and thresholds before future data access, separate prior conflict from model misfit, and require a new real-data preregistration for promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier empirical work covered adapter readiness, selection functions, likelihood schemas, simulation calibration, and posterior-predictive checks; none preregistered prior-family sensitivity and prior-data conflict as distinct diagnostics.

proposals.title: Blind scorer-reliability and adjudication-separation gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS scoring, inter-rater reliability, agreement, rater training, adjudication, blinded labels, matched budgets, measurement error, real arms, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered scorer-reliability protocol can separate agreement from adjudication and can expose unstable rubrics without unblinding outcomes or silently substituting synthetic raters for blind matched-budget real arms.
proposals.null_or_failure: Reliability and agreement are conflated, adjudication rewrites original ratings, rater exclusions are outcome-tuned, arm labels leak, training differs by arm, budgets differ, or synthetic ratings become THOS superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate rater blindness, training parity, rating retention, adjudication separation, missingness, agreement thresholds, budgets, and arm counts; reject protocol defects while keeping real-rater and real-arm counts at zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected scoring round, preserve original and adjudicated ratings separately, retain the negative, preregister a revised rubric before real execution, and keep all superiority and personhood-adjacent claims false.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS proposals addressed scorer proxies, rubric invariance, matched budgets, attrition, contamination, crossover, clusters, spillover, multiplicity, and sequential looks; none isolated inter-rater reliability from adjudication with original-rating retention.

proposals.title: Freed ID resolver-egress and metadata-minimization boundary
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic DID resolution, service endpoints, redirects, URL schemes, private address ranges, query normalization, requester metadata, caching, and production interoperability
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic resolver-egress profile can reject unsafe schemes, private-network targets, redirect expansion, query injection, and excessive requester metadata without claiming live resolution, real-key verification, or production interoperability.
proposals.null_or_failure: A service endpoint can reach loopback or private space, redirects escape the allowlist, encoded hosts bypass normalization, requester identifiers leak, draft DID Resolution wording is treated as stable, or synthetic egress checks become production cryptographic assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise HTTPS, unsupported scheme, loopback, private address, numeric-host, redirect-chain, query-injection, cache-key, and metadata-excess fixtures; fail closed with zero live resolvers, keys, proofs, or partners.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the synthetic resolution, retain the vector, restore the last coherent allowlist and metadata floor, and require standards-conformant real services, cryptography, interoperability, independent reviews, and trust governance for production claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Freed ID work covered structural conformance, lifecycle, status freshness, selective disclosure, cross-layer coherence, revocation races, and cryptosuite downgrade; it did not model resolver network egress and requester-metadata minimization.

proposals.title: Minority-dissent preservation and conflict-of-interest recusal authority gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR legitimacy, minority reports, dissent, recusal, conflicts of interest, representative authority, benefit and remedy terms, Māori authority, and competent legal or cultural decisions
proposals.hypothesis: A nonbinding technical gate can preserve dissent, require conflict disclosure and recusal, and refuse aggregation that erases a minority report, while remaining unable to appoint representatives or grant legal, cultural, affected-party, or Māori authority.
proposals.null_or_failure: A majority score erases dissent, a conflicted representative votes without disclosure, recusal removes remedy rights, silence is treated as consent, Māori authority is inferred from a technical role, or the artifact is treated as enacted law or cultural ratification.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run synthetic dissent, recusal, undisclosed-conflict, proxy-authority, withdrawal, benefit, Māori-authority, cultural, and legal vectors; require exact deferral whenever authorized participants are absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the decision, preserve dissent and remedy records, restore excluded voices, disclose conflicts without publishing private material, and defer to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior CBR work covered participation, empty chairs, veto, standing, remedies, consent withdrawal, delegated sunset, intergenerational appeal, and collective secondary-use authority; none centered minority-report preservation plus conflict disclosure and recusal.

proposals.title: Adversarial corpus minimization and test-oracle poisoning recovery
proposals.mission_surface: security negative tests, deterministic corpus reduction, oracle integrity, expected-result mutation, seed replay, crash quarantine, recovery, and bounded assurance
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic minimization contract can preserve the smallest failure-inducing adversarial fixture while detecting poisoned expected results and can recover without deleting the original corpus or claiming exhaustive security.
proposals.null_or_failure: Minimization changes the failure class, the oracle and fixture mutate together, a random seed is absent, a recovered pass erases the original crash, a security exception is broadened silently, or local tests become exhaustive assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate oracle digests, expected classes, seeds, minimization order, failure signatures, exception scopes, and negative retention; require fail-closed quarantine and replayable recovery.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the poisoned oracle, retain the original and minimized fixtures, restore the last signed expectation digest, rerun from a fixed seed, and keep exhaustive-security claims false.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier red-team work covered parser limits, TOCTOU swaps, artifact poisoning, path authorization, supply-chain integrity, and recovery; none preregistered failure-preserving corpus minimization against test-oracle poisoning.

proposals.title: Clock-locale-order determinism envelope and hermeticity gap
proposals.mission_surface: clean-snapshot repeatability, timestamps, locale, timezone, filesystem order, random seeds, normalized hashes, dependency closure, and independent reproduction
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic envelope can expose time, locale, timezone, ordering, and seed dependencies and can make same-owner builds reproducible across bounded perturbations while preserving any undeclared dependency as a hermeticity gap.
proposals.null_or_failure: Output embeds wall-clock time, locale changes sorting or numbers, filesystem iteration changes hashes, seeds are implicit, dependency versions are missing, normalized hashing hides semantic change, or local parity is called independent reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Perturb epoch, timezone, locale label, insertion order, seed, line endings, and dependency declaration; require semantic parity only for declared normalization and preserve every undeclared influence as a negative.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the divergent output, pin the causal input without rewriting history, regenerate in fresh detached D-drive snapshots, and keep independent-team reproduction open.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior reproduction work covered manifests, newline normalization, environment perturbation, dual oracles, common-mode budgets, challenge packets, and worktree leases; none isolated clock, locale, timezone, ordering, and seed nondeterminism in one hermeticity envelope.

proposals.title: Measurement-scale admissibility barrier for thermo-psyche analogies
proposals.mission_surface: thermodynamic and psychological quantities, nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio scales, units, admissible transforms, entropy language, construct validity, and category barriers
proposals.hypothesis: A measurement-scale classifier can reject arithmetic and invariance claims that are not admissible for a declared scale and can prevent ordinal or nominal psyche labels from being treated as thermodynamic state variables.
proposals.null_or_failure: Ordinal ranks are averaged as invariant quantities without assumptions, nominal labels enter arithmetic, interval zero is treated as absolute, unit-bearing thermodynamic quantities are equated to scale-free scores, or analogy becomes a fundamental thermo-psyche law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate scale type, admissible transformation, zero point, units, aggregation, entropy domain, causal language, and fundamental-law flags; reject inadmissible operations and category crossings.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the least committal scale classification, retain the counterexample, replace equations with clearly labeled heuristic prose where appropriate, and require empirical construct validation before any stronger claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier thermo-psyche work classified law types, tested construct validity and causal direction, separated Shannon from thermodynamic entropy, and enforced promotion burdens; none audited admissible operations by nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio scale.

proposals.title: Non-compensatory evidence vector and score-laundering rejection board
proposals.mission_surface: Stage 20 promotion, evidence dimensions, veto gates, weighted scores, missing authority, negative monotonicity, pass-fail-defer decisions, and terminal readiness
proposals.hypothesis: A non-compensatory evidence vector can prevent high local engineering scores from offsetting zero empirical, authority, production, or independent-reproduction evidence and can reject any scalar score that launders a veto gate.
proposals.null_or_failure: A weighted average promotes a claim despite a zero veto dimension, missing evidence is scored as neutral, an exact gate becomes a penalty, negatives shrink, protected claims turn true, or terminal readiness differs across artifacts.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate engineering scores, veto dimensions, missingness handling, gate classes, protected claims, negative counts, and terminal state; require exact pass, fail, or defer decisions with no compensatory promotion.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the promoted artifact, retain the score-laundering vector, regenerate derived views from canonical phase truth, and keep the terminal verdict not ready until every non-compensatory gate independently passes.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Stage 20 work covered contradiction, expiry, dependency cut sets, evidence order, freshness withdrawal, claim lattices, and escrow; none explicitly prohibited compensatory scalar scoring from offsetting veto dimensions.

scientific_authority_boundary: Empirical GMUT confirmation requires real measurements and likelihood evidence; THOS requires blind matched-budget real arms, real raters, and independent review; Freed ID production completion requires standards-conformant real cryptography, services, interoperability, review, and governance; CBR and Māori legitimacy remain exact-gated to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
claim_boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
